# Research report 1 of 2

I couldn't confirm SpaceX's latest price for this question: no source from September 16 or earlier gives a September 16 price. The last close I found is **$143.49 on Tuesday 15 September**, 4.4% below $150.00. Getting to $150 means gaining about 4.5% over three trading days (16, 17 and 18 September). The stock has often moved 2-4% in a single day. I left out every result dated after 16 September 2026, as the exercise requires.

## 4. Base rates and volatility
- 2026-06-12: SPCX listed at $135, then hit an all-time high of $225.64 on June 16. Since then it has trended down toward the $135-150 area. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Initial_public_offering_of_SpaceX), [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/equities/spacex)
- The stock is very volatile. Recent daily moves include -9% (August), -5% (9/9), -2.0% (9/14) and -3.15% (9/15). On 9/14 the high-to-low range was about 4.4%.
- With daily moves of roughly 2-4% and occasional moves of 5-9%, a 4.5% gain over three sessions is about a one-standard-deviation move. That kind of move is common for this stock, but it would mean recovering from two down days.
- Over early to mid September the stock traded roughly between $143 and $153. The $150 level was within that range.

- Polymarket runs weekly SPCX strike-price markets with "finish week above" brackets. I could not find their prices as of 2026-09-16. They resolve on Pyth 1-minute close data, not Google Finance. [Polymarket series](https://polymarket.com/series/spacex-multi-strikes-weekly)
- I found no Kalshi market and no pre-cutoff Manifold market for a Sept 18 close at or above $150.
